name: Scary Clowns & Vorath Nightmare Before Christmas Collection
theme: Dark Carnival Circus / Uncle Vorath Gothic Halloween Mythos

stickers.name: Giggles the Abyssal Harlequin Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Sinister vintage carnival clown with cracked porcelain face paint, razor-sharp needle teeth grin, and ornate polka-dot ruffled collar.

stickers.name: Chuckles the Willamette Drain Creeper Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Eerie horror clown holding a dripping crimson balloon emerging from a mossy antique sewer grate.

stickers.name: Pierrot the Melancholy Phantom Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Gothic monochrome Pierrot clown with teardrop makeup, weeping black rose, and wind-up music box with floating spectral melodies.

stickers.name: Jack-in-the-Box Carny Ghoul Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Crazed grinning clown popping explosively out of an antique Victorian wind-up music box with flaming juggling pins.

stickers.name: Twisted Funhouse Ringmaster Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Towering sinister carnival ringmaster clown with hypnotic spiral eyes, playing cards in hat, and skull bone cane.

stickers.name: Detective Vorath: The Pumpkin King Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Detective Uncle Vorath reimagined as the Pumpkin King on Spiral Hill in pinstripe trench coat with brass monocle and magnifying glass.

stickers.name: Sally the Cascadia Patchwork Alchemist Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Gothic ragdoll maiden in autumn flannel patchwork dress holding a smoking glass apothecary bottle of autumn elixir.

stickers.name: Oogie Boogie Eldritch Spore Titan Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Massive burlap scarecrow titan stitched with rough twine, glowing with neon mycelium spores, rolling red gaming dice.

stickers.name: Zero the Ghostly Spirit Hound Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Ethereal translucent floating ghost pup with a glowing orange miniature jack-o-lantern nose lighting misty autumn paths.

stickers.name: The Mayor: Two-Faced Clockwork Politician Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Victorian Halloween town mayor with a rotating dual face (beaming smile / sweating terror), stovepipe hat, brass megaphone, and pocket watch.

stickers.name: Dr. Finkelstein Steampunk Clockwork Anatomist Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Eccentric mad scientist in a motorized brass steampunk wheelchair with flip-top skull revealing a glowing crystal vacuum-tube brain.

stickers.name: Lock, Shock & Barrel: Cascadia Mischief Imps Diecut Sticker
stickers.description: Three masked trick-or-treat kids riding inside an antique walking mechanical clawfoot bathtub overflowing with candy.
